steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Send Vendor A the counter-offer reducing the price from 100 to 90.
Verify that the counter-offer was initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the counter-offer in the supplier portal.
The prepared-state catalog cannot close this in-evaluation event.
Open the comparison grid after the event is closed.
Verify the accepted counter-offer rate is 90 per unit.
Verify the total for 10 units is 900.
Award the available bid to Vendor A after closure.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
